subject: Creativity
title: Lucid Dreaming: Controlling Your Dream Imagination
description: Learn Lucid Dreaming: Controlling Your Dream Imagination in one minute.

hook.text: In a lucid dream, you know you're dreaming — and you can direct the dream.

buildup.text: About 55% of people have had at least one lucid dream. Only 23% experience them monthly or more.

discovery.text: During lucid dreams, the prefrontal cortex partially reactivates — giving you executive control within the dream state.

twist.text: Salvador Dali used hypnagogic naps, dozing with a key in hand to catch dream imagery.

climax.text: Studies show lucid dreamers can practice motor skills in dreams and improve real-world performance upon waking.

punchline.text: Your dreams are a creative lab. Lucid dreaming hands you the keys.

quiz.question: What technique did Salvador Dalí use to capture dream imagery?
options: Hypnagogic naps with a key in hand
